correctness.rationale: The one-start rotation is unbordered exactly when the first zero gap is shorter than the trailing gap; the reversal supplies the complementary comparison. Every unbordered shift must cross a binary symbol boundary and is counted exactly once by an unequal adjacent cyclic-gap pair. Ordered gap triples with all equal, exactly two equal and all distinct have counts 1 (when 3|n), 3(floor((n-3)/2)+1-delta), and the complement. Three marked one positions per word vs n starting positions per triple gives 3C_j=nT_j even for periodic cases. The independent direct-border verifier passed all 10,626 weight-three words for lengths 3..23, and exact gap tallies through n=120. Boundaries and quantifiers checked; finite tests are corroboration only.

value.rationale: Unbordered conjugates are a classical structural invariant of words, with earlier research on binary correlation patterns, maximum shifts and the fully bordered extremal class. Exactly three ones is the first small fixed-content layer where the third unbordered conjugate arises. The complete exact infinite-length multiplicity spectrum, including periodic exceptions and typical three-shift prevalence, answers a natural conditional enumeration not captured by the published extremal/mean results, and provides an explicit mechanism linking boundary structure to gap equality. It is not claimed to generalize to other weights.
